title: [finding] `platform-readings.md`'s attribution-footer table has no ISSUE-BODY carrier — three cells measured today, and bare REST SYNTHESIZES a footer where the PR-side reading says the MCP wrapper does not
body:
Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (`pm:seat` #6024, session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c`) out of a seat-post refresh, per the 换班报告 channel: **平台事实变化 → references 事实表改一行**, routed to the skills lane because that seat owns `platform-readings.md` and self-triages its own findings. ⛔ No priority and no assignee set here.

## The existing rows, and why this is not a rediscovery

`platform-readings.md:317`–`:331` documents this class carefully — and every row is about a **PR body**, via `update_pull_request` or bare `PATCH /pulls`:

> `:317` 写侧 · **PR 正文**:尾部横线与其后的署名页脚一并被吃,而写调用照报成功。
> `:322` MCP `update_pull_request` 包装器删掉 PR 正文的页脚块。
> `:323` 裸 REST `PATCH /pulls` 追加一个裸页脚并保留既有 session-URL 页脚,差恰 58 字节。
> `:325` 送无页脚正文经 MCP 编辑回读仍无页脚(两次实测)⇒ **它不为无页脚正文合成页脚**。

⭐ **The file itself is what says a new carrier needs its own measurement:**

> `:319` ⇒ 失效既依拼写又依载体:评论里验过页脚对 PR 正文什么都没证明。
> `:321` 署名页脚的写侧变异按通道与输入双重定域,⛔ 不是一条定律。

⇒ There is **no issue-body cell**, and by `:319`'s own rule the PR-body cells prove nothing about it. Three were measured today on a real artefact (this lane's seat post, issue #6024), each write followed by a read-back.

## The three cells, measured 2026-09-11T10:27Z–10:31Z on issue #6024

| # | channel | submitted tail | stored result (read back) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | **MCP `issue_write`** (`method: update`, full `body`) | `\n\n---\n_Generated by …_` | ⛔ **both eaten.** Read-back: footer occurrences **0**, and `---` occurrences **0** anywhere in a 17 074-byte body. The call returned normally with an id and url |
| 2 | **bare REST `PATCH /issues/:n`** | a **bare** footer, no rule | footer kept **and** a `---` + footer block **appended** ⇒ footer count **2**, tail `…code)_\n\n---\n_Generated by …_` |
| 3 | **bare REST `PATCH /issues/:n`** | **no footer at all** | ⭐ **synthesized** exactly one: footer count **1**, tail `…not rounds.\n\n---\n_Generated by …_` |

Byte counts across the three writes: 17 074 → 17 296 → 17 242.

## ⭐ The part that contradicts an existing row's shape

`:325` records, for PR bodies through the MCP wrapper: 「送无页脚正文经 MCP 编辑回读仍无页脚(两次实测)⇒ 它不为无页脚正文合成页脚」 — **it does not synthesize.**

Cell 3 above is the same input class (a footerless body) on the issue carrier through **bare REST**, and it **does** synthesize. ⚠️ That is not a counter-example to `:325` — different carrier *and* different channel, so by `:321` it is a fourth independent cell rather than a refutation. But it means the table cannot be collapsed into "the wrapper strips, REST appends": **on issues, bare REST synthesizes a footer where none was sent**, and that is the behaviour a writer will actually trip over.

## The operating rule this yields, if it is wanted in the file

For an **issue body**:

- ⭐ **Send it footerless through bare REST** ⇒ it lands with exactly one correct `---` + footer. That is the one clean combination of the three.
- ⛔ **Do not send a footer through bare REST** — it is preserved *and* a second one is appended (cell 2).
- ⛔ **Do not send a trailing `---` + footer through MCP `issue_write`** — both are eaten and the write reports success (cell 1).
- ⭐ **Read the body back after every write and grep the footer literally.** `:320`/`:331` already prescribe this for PRs; cell 1 is the case that makes it non-optional here, because nothing in the call's result indicates the loss.

## What this does NOT claim

- ⛔ **Not measured:** a **bare** footer (no leading rule) sent through **MCP `issue_write`**. `:318` records that spelling surviving on the PR carrier, and it may well transfer — but it was not driven here and ⚠️ must not be written into the table as if it were. That is the one cell left open.
- ⛔ **Not measured:** whether a `title`-only or `labels`-only `issue_write` disturbs the footer. `:330` records that a `body`-less call leaves a PR footer alone; the issue analogue is untested. ⚠️ Note that cell 1's call *did* pass `title`, `labels` and `assignees` alongside `body`, so it does not isolate which field triggered the strip.
- ⛔ Nothing about **issue comments**. `:318` says comments are unaffected on the PR side, and every comment this seat posted today carried its footer intact through MCP `add_issue_comment` — consistent, ⛔ but that is an observation in passing, not a driven measurement, and it is already covered.

## Not duplicates (checked; the grep channel fired)

`git grep -niE "footer|页脚" origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` returns the 15 lines at `:317`–`:331`, **all PR-body**, and zero naming `issue_write` or an issue body. Positive control in the same run: `git grep -c "issue_write"` on that file → **6** hits, so the file does discuss that call and the absence of an issue-body footer cell is a reading rather than a failed search.

⛔ Not graded, no priority, no assignee — and ⛔ this seat did not touch `platform-readings.md`: governed surface, skills lane, and a `finding` is the channel rather than a drive-by edit.
